name: seedance_generate
description: Generate video via Seedance (ByteDance) on fal.ai. Mode follows the inputs: text only (t2v), --image for image-to-video (i2v), --ref-image for reference-to-video (r2v). Standalone only.

params.name: image
params.description: Starting image (first frame). Mutually exclusive with --ref-image.

params.name: duration
params.description: Clip length in seconds, or 'auto'. Range is model-dependent.

params.name: resolution
params.description: 480p|720p|1080p|4k. Availability is model-dependent (4k is seedance-2.0 only).

params.name: model
params.description: seedance-2.5 is the default and best model.

params.name: seed
params.description: RNG seed. Only used in modes that support one (2.5 reference-to-video); dropped with a warning elsewhere.

params.name: sound
params.description: Generate audio with the clip (costs more). Off by default.

params.name: negative-prompt
params.description: Things to avoid. Seedance has no negative-prompt field; appended to the prompt as 'Avoid: ...'.
